incidents.body:
Summary: From 10:20 AM to 3:00 PM PDT on April 27th, a global Databricks Compute outage resulted in failed audience preview queries across external workspaces.
Details: The disruption was caused by an upstream infrastructure failure at Databricks, which prevented some preview queries from executing successfully. This issue was localized to the dashboard preview tool; real-time event delivery and audience activations were not impacted.
Resolution: The underlying compute issue has been resolved by the vendor. We have confirmed that preview functionality is fully restored and operating normally.
incidents.title: Audience Preview Failures

incidents.body:
Summary: Between 9:24 AM PST on March 19 and 9:38 AM PST on March 19, the engineering team performed a database upgrade. During this window, users may have experienced degraded performance specifically on the Audiences Overview webpage.

Notification Update:
Some customers may have received automated email notifications citing "Audience Run Failures" during this time. Please be advised that these were false positives triggered by the maintenance; no actual failures occurred, and all background processes completed successfully.

Status:
Functionality was fully restored and all systems were confirmed stable as of 9:38 AM PST. We apologize for the inconvenience.
